issues.detail: The instructions focus on happy path usage and do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing dependencies or unsupported formats.
The skill file contains extensive explanatory text and guidelines that add verbosity beyond the core instructions.
The install instructions rely on macOS brew and Debian/Ubuntu apt, indicating minor platform assumptions.
